EQUIPMENT CHECKOUT

Check out equipment without slowing the crew down.

Scan the label, choose take, move, or return, and let Fieldmark keep a dependable record behind the simple action.

Try the field flow →

Equipment checkout that is ready when the truck is ready.

A paper sign-out sheet is easy to skip. Fieldmark makes the check-out action a quick scan in a phone browser, then records the tool, person, time, and location.

Take

Assign an item to a worker at the moment it leaves.

Move

Transfer an item between people, trucks, job sites, and the shop.

Return

Complete the handoff and keep the record available for later.

What happens when a checkout is wrong?

Make a correction as a visible follow-on event. This protects the real history while ensuring the current tool status is accurate.
